notes: Critical fix: the after-hours guards from the last two releases only blocked the Alpaca order, not the local close -- a blocked exit could leave the app showing a position as sold while Alpaca still held it. Now checked before any local state changes, and this also covers the actual reported bug (partial-profit exits, which used a different, previously-unguarded submission path). Also renamed GapUpExitManager/GapUpCrawlTask to PositionExitManager/PositionExitCrawlTask to match their existing 'Position Exit Monitor' label.
